text: Canonical JSON digests shall be SHA-256 of UTF-8 JSON with sorted object keys, no insignificant whitespace, unescaped non-ASCII, no normalization, and significant array order. Duplicate keys/floating numbers shall be rejected. Index shall pin profile digests; profiles shall pin shared-contract digest; no digest shall include itself.
clause_basis: Conservative sentence/semicolon seed groups; semantic clause review required before closure.
